# EnumMustRespectType

**Severity:** error

**Applies to:** Resource Manager (ARM)

Enum values must match their declared type.

| ID          | Violation | Description                                        |
| ----------- | --------- | -------------------------------------------------- |
| `compliant` | false     | Standard TypeSpec compiles without violating rule   |
